rationale: Calculated short-circuit currents for three fault locations. Max 3-phase fault is 9.304 kA at near bus (0.2 km). Min 2-phase fault is 1.508 kA at remote end (8.0 km). Breaker rating selected as 12.5 kA (smallest standard rating above 9.304 * 1.1 = 10.23 kA). Relay pickup set to 600 A primary, satisfying load margin constraint (>= 450 A) and minimum fault sensitivity constraint (<= 754 A).
